summary: Updated implementation plan with root-cause diagnosis and fixes for: (1) Filemoon 1-minute extraction delay -> reduced to 1-3 seconds by fixing the Packer radix/symtab regex, adding native Kotlin JS Packer evaluation, and instant iframe fast-pathing; (2) Permanent app freeze on Download button tap -> fixed by eliminating synchronous Base64 segment bridging over the Android main thread, removing raw HLS playlist fetches from parseHlsManifestOnDevice during UI probes, and sanitizing persisted localStorage tasks on startup.
